accounts.description: One entry per IMAP account to synchronise. Each entry drives an IMAPAccount, IMAPStore, MaildirStore, and Channel block.

name.description: Short identifier (no spaces) used as a prefix for store and channel names, e.g. 'work' or 'personal'.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the IMAP server.

port.description: TCP port. Use 993 for IMAPS (implicit TLS) or 143 for STARTTLS / plain.

user.description: IMAP login username, usually the full e-mail address.

pass_cmd.description: Shell command whose stdout provides the account password. Use a secrets manager (pass, gpg, secret-tool) to avoid storing credentials in plaintext.

ssl_type.description: Encryption mode: IMAPS (implicit TLS on the dedicated port), STARTTLS (upgrade on port 143), or None (no encryption — not recommended).

ssl_versions.description: Space-separated list of TLS versions the client will accept. Restrict to TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 for modern security.

cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate bundle for verifying the server certificate. Leave empty to let OpenSSL use its compiled-in default paths.

auth_mechs.description: Space-separated SASL mechanisms to attempt. LOGIN and PLAIN work everywhere; GSSAPI for Kerberos environments.

timeout.description: Seconds before an idle connection is considered dead and closed. 0 defers to the OS TCP keepalive setting.

subfolder_style.description: How IMAP folder hierarchy maps to Maildir sub-directories. Verbatim keeps IMAP names unchanged; Maildir++ uses a dot-delimited flat layout; Legacy uses a slash-delimited tree.

local_path.description: Root path for the local Maildir tree. Must end with a trailing slash. Tilde is expanded.

inbox_path.description: Absolute or tilde-prefixed path to the local INBOX folder. Often placed directly under the root path.

patterns.description: IMAP folder name globs to synchronise. Use ['*'] to sync all folders, or list specific names such as ['INBOX', 'Sent', 'Drafts', 'Archive'].

create.description: Auto-create missing folders on which side: Both, Far (remote), Near (local), or None. Near is safe for a laptop that mirrors a server.

expunge.description: Permanently delete messages marked \Deleted after sync: Both, Far, Near, or None. None is the safest default — expunge manually when confident.

sync_state.description: UID state file location. The special value * stores a .mbsyncstate file inside each Maildir folder, which is the most portable choice.

sync.description: Sync scope: All (full bidirectional), Pull (remote→local only), Push (local→remote only), or a space-separated list of flags like PullNew PushNew.

max_messages.description: Keep only the newest N messages locally per folder. 0 disables the limit and downloads everything.

max_size.description: Skip messages larger than this many bytes. Useful to avoid downloading large attachments on metered connections. 0 disables the limit.

group_name.description: Name for a Group block that aggregates all channels. Run 'mbsync <group_name>' to sync every account at once. Leave empty to omit the Group block.
